values.meaning: Slow linger duration after leaving the area
values.quote: The slow lingers for 1 second after leaving the area.

mechanics.claim: The ability can be recast at any time while in flight or during the duration, and automatically detonates after the duration ends.
mechanics.quote: ''Lucent Singularity'' can be recast at any time while it is in flight or within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration.

mechanics.claim: If recast while the projectile is still in flight, it detonates immediately upon arrival instead of waiting.
mechanics.quote: If ''Lucent Singularity'' was recast while in flight, it will detonate upon arrival.

mechanics.claim: Enemies hit by the detonation are also slowed by the same amount, for 1 second.
mechanics.quote: Enemies hit by ''Lucent Singularity's'' detonation are also slowed by the same amount for 1 second.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown starts on cast, not on detonation.
The initial cast counts as an ability activation for on-cast effects, but the manual recast does not.
mechanics.quote: The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
